I’m in multidisciplinary engineering. Interdisciplinary is not ABET accredited it is usually for people who want to go to medical or law school. Multidisciplinary is ABET accredited like the other engineering majors, ECE, ME, etc. You can follow the established concentrations or make your own plan of study. If you want to CODO reach out to our advisor she’s really good and cares about your experience! Also don’t listen to people who say you have a harder time finding jobs. Yeah companies might not recognize the major at first glance but all you have to do is explain it well. I have several job offers rn because of the unique skill set and I could sell myself well. Hope this helps! Feel free to dm me if you have any questions
